en.title: CityEL: A web-based platform to support city-scale building energy efficiency based on AutoBPS
en.authors: Chengcheng Song, Jingjing Yang, Zhiyuan Wang, Ruoheng Li, Xiufeng Pang, Yixing Chen*
en.abstract: CityEL (City Energy Lab) is a web-based platform for urban building energy efficiency. Unlike traditional UBEM tools, it focuses on rapid modeling and neighborhood-scale analysis, using GIS and AutoBPS to streamline energy benchmarking, retrofit evaluation, and cost analysis.

en.title: Developing urban building energy models for shanghai city with multi-source open data
en.authors: Chengcheng Song, Zhang Deng, Wenxian Zhao, Yue Yuan, Mengyue Liu, Shen Xu, Yixing Chen*
en.abstract: This study integrates open data to model Shanghai's building energy use, covering 609,000 footprints. Using machine learning, 63 building prototypes were classified with 95% accuracy, and energy simulations aligned with benchmarks. The approach improves urban energy modeling for sustainability planning.

en.title: An emergency aircraft evacuation simulation considering passenger overtaking and luggage retrieval
en.authors: Chengcheng Song, Quan Shao*, Pei Zhu, Min Dong, Wenfei Yu
en.abstract: This study models cabin evacuation with cellular automata, analyzing how luggage retrieval and overtaking behaviors impact efficiency. Results show luggage retrieval hinders evacuation most, but effective crew guidance can improve safety.

zh.title: CityEL: A web-based platform to support city-scale building energy efficiency based on AutoBPS
zh.authors: 宋乘成, 杨晶晶, 王志远, 李若恒, 逄秀峰, 陈毅兴*
zh.abstract: CityEL (City Energy Lab)是一个面向城市建筑能效的Web平台。与传统UBEM工具不同，它专注于快速建模和社区尺度分析，利用GIS和AutoBPS简化能源基准测试、改造评估和成本分析。

zh.title: Developing urban building energy models for shanghai city with multi-source open data
zh.authors: 宋乘成, 邓章, 赵文娴, 袁玥, 刘梦月, 徐燊, 陈毅兴*
zh.abstract: 本研究整合开放数据对上海市的建筑能源使用进行建模，覆盖609,000个建筑轮廓。通过机器学习，63个建筑原型以95%的准确率进行分类，能源模拟与基准一致。该方法改进了城市能源建模，促进可持续规划。

zh.title: An emergency aircraft evacuation simulation considering passenger overtaking and luggage retrieval
zh.authors: 宋乘成, 邵荃*, 朱培, 董敏, 于文斐
zh.abstract: 本研究使用元胞自动机对机舱疏散进行建模，分析行李提取和超车行为如何影响疏散效率。结果表明行李提取最阻碍疏散，但有效的机组人员指导可以提高安全性。
